title: GOOD: hlc_persist uses INSERT ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE — idempotent checkpoint upsert
description: hlc_persist.rs: save_hlc_checkpoint uses INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET ... for the single-row hlc_checkpoint table. This is idempotent — calling it multiple times with the same data is safe, and a first-run (no row yet) is handled without a separate INSERT path. The fallibility is propagated to the caller which logs the error but does not abort the daemon. Decision: correct upsert pattern for a single-row config/state table.
